checks._about: Deterministic checks the harness runs in Chromium inside the product's own sandbox wrapper (CSP + sandbox=allow-scripts), at every viewport. Each is pass/fail and recorded; the skill is judged on these first, then on screenshots a person looks at.
checks.load_ok: the document runs with no uncaught error, no CSP violation, no blocked request, and no storage/dialog API call that the sandbox refuses
checks.no_external: no src/href/url() that leaves the document
checks.charts_via_echarts_runtime: every chart is an ECharts instance in this document and the document carries the ECharts library exactly once; no hand-built axes or ticks (niceTicks, createElementNS svg charts) in the report's own script; no nested iframes of chart pages
checks.no_horizontal_overflow: documentElement.scrollWidth <= viewport width at every viewport, on every page
checks.pages_or_sections: if the task asks for pages: more than one tab with working keyboard-accessible switching; each page shows its charts at the right size after switching
checks.slicer_changes_chart: choosing another slicer value changes the data the chart holds (dataset rows or series data), and reset restores it
checks.legend_not_dominant: legend and title font sizes are not larger than the chart's axis labels by more than 25%, and the legend does not take more than 30% of the chart height
checks.chart_min_size: no chart is narrower than min(viewport width minus 32px, 280px) or shorter than 200px; no plot area is narrower than 50% of the chart width
checks.tap_targets: interactive controls at least 36px high at phone widths
checks.restraint_no_tabs_no_slicers: a brief asks for neither tabs nor slicers: none are rendered
checks.controls_change_output: moving a slider or choosing a scenario changes the plotted series
checks.skills_loaded: from the Run's tool calls: which skills were loaded, in which order, and which of their reference files were read
checks.no_boilerplate: the visible text carries no subject-unrelated declaration: AI-generation or model/tool credits, disclaimers ('仅供参考', '不构成…建议', disclaimer, 'for reference only', 'not financial advice'), privacy / compliance / cookie / copyright notices ('隐私政策', 'cookie', 'GDPR', '版权所有', '©', 'all rights reserved'), generated-on / powered-by footers, calls to action. A data source line, an as-of date, the method, and the assumptions or limits that bear on THIS analysis are content, not boilerplate. Report every hit with the phrase and the element that holds it.
checks.html_published: the Run published an HTML artifact (attach_artifact of an .html file); a report pasted only into the answer text does not count
checks.timeline_or_events: heuristic: the document holds at least five entries that begin with a year or a date, inside a list, a table or a .timeline element
checks.assumptions_stated: heuristic: visible text has a heading or lead-in containing 假设 or assumption(s), followed by at least one sentence with a number

_routing_semantics: load = skills that must ALL be loaded before the stop condition; forbid = none may be loaded; allow = skills that may be loaded without counting against precision; max_tool_calls/max_seconds override the defaults (8 calls, 180 s) for cases where the model researches before it builds; history = earlier turns the case refers to.
